messages:
Anya: Putting a tracker here for the dedicated capacity roadmap item: "region-aware burst pools". Goal: let customers reserve headroom per-region + opt into fast local burst that doesn't steal global capacity. Thoughts?
Marcos: 👍 I like region isolation. Major win for customers with latency-sensitive traffic in EU/US/APAC. Need to think about cross-region spillover when a region is saturated.
Priya: From product POV, customers want predictability and a simple billing model. Proposal: reserved pool per-region (monthly commit) + burst bandwidth priced per-minute used above baseline.
Sam: Implementation flag: runtime must prefer local node allocation and only fall back to remote if latency budget allows. We should encode a fallback policy with TTL. Example policy: region_prefer -> cross_region_fallback if latency < 120ms.
Anya: Also need to decide quota semantics: do regional bursts consume the customer's global reserved tokens or separate regional credits? Two options: (A) separate regional credits (clean accounting) (B) draws from global reserve but with soft masks per-region.
Marcos: A gives clearer invoices but increases purchase friction. B is easier for customers who want a single commit and don't want to manage per-region splits. Could offer both: default B, optional A for enterprise customers.
Priya: Agree. Default = single reserved commit with admin-set regional allocations. Enterprise = explicit regional commitments. We'll add in dashboard UI: slider per-region.
Sam: Autoscale interaction: if regional burst drives autoscale, we need guardrails so the pool doesn't instantly scale other regions' capacity. Suggest per-region scale decisions and a global spillover limiter.
Anya: We should also run a simulation harness to model cost impacts and tail latencies under different traffic shapes. Marcos, can your team run traffic replay for a few customer traces?
Marcos: Yep. I can get 3 anonymized traces (chat-heavy, ingest-heavy, mixed). Need to know the policy knobs to test: burst_window, tokens_per_sec, cross_region_tolerance_ms, spillover_limit_percent.
Priya: Also add a billing scenario generator so finance can see sample invoices for pilot customers. BillingBot: can you produce sample invoice lines for: baseline reserved, regional burst minutes, cross-region spillover units?
BillingBot: Generating sample invoice lines... (mock)
- reserved_commit: USD 5,000/month
- region_eu_burst_minutes: 120 -> USD 60
- spillover_units: 2000 tokens -> USD 2
(These are mocks for discussion only.)
Sam: Nice. Launch criteria thought: 1) runtime enforces region-prefer allocation in canary, 2) simulation report showing <5% p99 latency increase for non-burst tenants, 3) billing emits separate line items in staging invoices, 4) dashboard region sliders + API, 5) runbook for ops.
Priya: Customer ask: FinPay wants guaranteed 5s burst windows in EU with 8k tokens/sec for peak reconciliation jobs. Can we support sub-10s windows?
Sam: Short windows are tricky because of metric granularity and autoscale hysteresis. We can support down to 5s but need to treat them as "microbursts" with a special path that avoids autoscale triggering — effectively local ephemeral prewarm. Ops review required for >4k tps in pilot.
Marcos: Simulation will include a microburst mode. We'll test with 5s and 30s windows.
Anya: Risk log: (1) billing confusion over per-minute vs per-second billing, (2) complexity in multi-region routing & failure modes, (3) potential thrash of autoscaler. Mitigations: clear invoices + naming, fallback policies w/ rate limiters, and a cooldown hysteresis default 180s for regional scale events.
Priya: For MVP scope keep it minimal: - regional preference routing, - per-region meter + invoice line, - dashboard slider + API, - basic spillover behavior (reject or best-effort). Exclude automatic cross-region autoscale for MVP.
Marcos: Dev tasks I see: traffic replay harness, region-aware allocator changes, telemetry tag `region_burst_v1`, and a dashboard prototype. Sam: Runtime tasks: implement allocator, enforce policy TTL, add cooldown.
Sam: Pseudo-config we'll use in proto:
```
route: "/reconcile"
region_policy:
  prefer: eu-west-1
  spillover_limit_percent: 20
  microburst:
    enabled: true
    window_ms: 5000
    tokens_per_sec: 8000
cooldown_seconds: 180
```
Priya: Need legal/finance for pilot pricing. Lina from sales will gather 2-3 pilot buyers.
Anya: Action items: Marcos -> collect traces + run sims by Fri; Sam -> prototype allocator change + PR; Priya -> draft pilot pricing and UI copy; BillingBot -> demo sample invoice export; Anya -> add to Q3 roadmap board and schedule pilot outreach.
OpsBot: Canary scheduled 2026-05-10T14:00Z for region-burst-v1.
Marcos: thumbs up. I'll loop in Lina for pilots.
Anya: No objections. We'll treat cross-region autoscale as a follow-up (Q4) after we collect telemetry. Meeting follow-up: sync Thurs 11:00 to review simulation results.
